name: project-brain
description: Git-native project memory, UI/Backend quality enforcement, task complexity scoring, source-bound verification, and economical orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, verify, review, and resume projects with Git-native memory and optional CLI Agent Pool orchestration
interface.longDescription: Project Brain 4.0.5 keeps plans, architecture and verification evidence in Git with an acyclic, dependency-free Python 3.8+ runtime. Core mode runs standalone with safe defaults (solo or host native agents, single-line session confirmation, source-bound proof and independent review); optional power features integrate with the separate CLI Agent Pool (CAP) companion for multi-CLI execution, durable SQLite runs, Quota Recovery (QRP), and Baton Relay (BRP).
